name: docmost-tools
description: Browser-authenticated MCP with private snapshots, guarded rich-page writes, and verified PDF attachment imports.

interface.shortDescription: Use a private Docmost instance through MCP.
interface.longDescription: Guarded reads, bounded ProseMirror JSON, private receipt-only workspace snapshots, prompt-gated rich-page writes, and checksum-verified PDF attachment imports for a private Docmost instance with isolated browser authentication.
defaultPrompt: Use Docmost Tools to read, write, and interact with my private Docmost workspace.
Use $docmost-attachment-import to place PDF reports in matching Docmost child pages.
